critique: The motion now convincingly reads as a Point Rise: between t1 and t4, a narrow white source emits a clearly upward, tapered stream on black. The overall silhouette and directional ascent match the preset intent well. However, the t4 particles are still somewhat gray/soft and the base remains a dense bright knot, so the individual points are less crisp and distinct than the thumbnail-like preset treatment.

suggestions.why: Reduce emission density so the source is less of a solid bright knot and individual ascending particles separate more clearly.
Lower particle feathering to make the white points crisper and more legible against black.
